USER GUIDE
1. WHAT IS THIS MANIPULATIVE?
TRIANGULAR COMBINATORICS & PART-WHOLE PAIRS
A double-six domino set is a complete triangular combinatorics system.It contains all unordered pairs [a|b] from 0 to 6: Total Tiles = T(7) = (7 × 8) / 2 = 28 Unique TilesDomino pips reinforce dice-pattern subitizing while each tileacts as a two-part additive partition of whole numbers 0 to 12!
MODULAR 28.0 × 14.0 MM TILE DATUM {xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n
12-FRAME REGROUPING TRAY & DOUBLES LID
The modular lid features a partitioned 7-slot doubles spinerail [0|0] through [6|6] and a dual 6-bay regrouping tray tobuild associative trains and model part-whole sums up to 14!
DOMINO SUBITIZING & SUM: [5|4] + [3|2] = 14
[5|4] = 9
[3|2] = 5
PART-WHOLE ADDITION [5|4] pips = 9 [3|2] pips = 5 Total: 9 + 5 = 14 T(7) = 7×8/2 = 28 Tiles Double-Six Combinatorics

3. WHY KEEP THIS REFERENCE CARD?
✓ NO LOST PIECE LEFT BEHIND
Classroom manipulatives get lost. Never abandon an incomplete set! Every individual math component is permanently stocked for single replacements.
Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts Order individual replacement pieces anytime
✓ 10-SECOND SELF-CHECKING PACK-UP
Pack-up is a built-in math game! Arrange the 28 standard tilesand 2 wildcards into four neat columns of 7 and one row of 2 inthe box floor. A missing tile breaks the smooth rectangular brick!Organizer lid snaps flush for silent zero-rattle carry.
✓ HANDS-ON TUTORIAL ON REVERSE
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage arrangements, calculator cross-references, and The Big Aha! conceptual breakthrough! Keep this card stored inside the box lid!
